# Coverage of Source's declared surface

**Generated by `SdkCoverageTests`. Do not edit.** Extracted from `source-sdk-2013` and
diffed against the sets this project maintains, so it cannot drift from the engine
without the engine changing.

A name here is something the ENGINE declares, not something this viewer needs equally:
`$cloakPassEnabled` sits on 307 materials and shows nothing until a spy cloaks, while
`$phong` is on 330 and every model is dull without it. `docs/CONFORMANCE.md` carries what
each gap COSTS; this carries how many there are.
